description: PostgreSQL 18 JSONB canonicalization, operators, functions, records, subscripting, aggregates, ordering, and GIN query behavior
sql: CREATE TABLE type_matrix_jsonb_operations (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, payload JSONB NOT NULL);

INSERT INTO type_matrix_jsonb_operations VALUES (1, '{"kind":"patient","active":true,"tags":["urgent","west"],"nested":{"score":1.00}}'), (2, '{"kind":"patient","active":false,"tags":["east"]}'), (3, '{"kind":"invoice","nested":{"kind":"patient"}}'), (4, '{"other":1}');
SELECT '{"aa":1,"b":2,"aa":3,"n":1.2300e+02}'::jsonb AS canonical;
CREATE TABLE type_matrix_jsonb_ordering (value JSONB PRIMARY KEY);
INSERT INTO type_matrix_jsonb_ordering VALUES ('null'), ('"a"'), ('0'), ('false'), ('[]'), ('[1]'), ('{}');
SELECT value FROM type_matrix_jsonb_ordering ORDER BY value;

SELECT payload->'nested'->>'score' AS score, payload#>>'{tags,0}' AS first_tag, payload @> '{"kind":"patient"}' AS contains_patient, payload ? 'active' AS has_active, payload ?| ARRAY['missing','tags'] AS has_any, payload ?& ARRAY['kind','active'] AS has_all FROM type_matrix_jsonb_operations WHERE id = 1;
SELECT jsonb_build_object('a', 1, 'missing', NULL), jsonb_build_array(1, NULL, 'x'), jsonb_object(ARRAY['a','b'], ARRAY['1',NULL]), to_jsonb('plain text'::text);

SELECT jsonb_array_element('[10,20]'::jsonb, -1), jsonb_array_element_text('[10,null]'::jsonb, 1), jsonb_object_field('{"a":{"b":1}}'::jsonb, 'a'), jsonb_object_field_text('{"a":null}'::jsonb, 'a'), jsonb_send('{"a":1}'::jsonb);

SELECT jsonb_set('{"a":[1,2]}'::jsonb, '{a,-1}', '9'), jsonb_insert('[0,1,2]'::jsonb, '{1}', '9', false), jsonb_insert('[0,1,2]'::jsonb, '{1}', '9', true), jsonb_strip_nulls('{"a":null,"b":[null,1]}'::jsonb);

SELECT jsonb_set_lax('{"a":1}'::jsonb, '{a}', NULL, true, 'use_json_null'), jsonb_set_lax('{"a":1}'::jsonb, '{a}', NULL, true, 'delete_key'), jsonb_set_lax('{"a":1}'::jsonb, '{a}', NULL, true, 'return_target');
SELECT ('{"items":[10,20],"0":"zero"}'::jsonb)['items'][0] AS first_item, ('[10,20]'::jsonb)[-1] AS last_item, ('{"0":"zero"}'::jsonb)[0] AS numeric_key, ('{"a":1}'::jsonb)['missing'] AS missing;
SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements('[1,{"a":2},null]'::jsonb);
SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements_text('[null,"x",{"a":2}]'::jsonb);
SELECT * FROM jsonb_object_keys('{"aa":1,"b":2,"a":3}'::jsonb);
SELECT key, value FROM jsonb_each('{"aa":1,"b":null}'::jsonb);
SELECT key, value FROM jsonb_each_text('{"a":null,"b":2}'::jsonb);
SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_record('{"a":1,"b":"x","c":true}'::jsonb) AS x(a integer, b text, c boolean, missing text);
SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset('[{"a":1,"b":"x"},{"a":2,"c":true}]'::jsonb) AS x(a integer, b text, c boolean);
SELECT * FROM jsonb_populate_record(NULL::record, '{"a":1,"b":"x"}'::jsonb) AS x(a integer, b text);
CREATE TABLE type_matrix_jsonb_aggregates (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, key_name TEXT, value_number INTEGER);
INSERT INTO type_matrix_jsonb_aggregates VALUES (1, 'a', 1), (2, 'b', NULL), (3, 'a', 3), (4, 'c', 2);

SELECT jsonb_agg(value_number ORDER BY id), jsonb_agg_strict(value_number ORDER BY id), jsonb_object_agg(key_name, value_number ORDER BY id), jsonb_object_agg_strict(key_name, value_number ORDER BY id) FROM type_matrix_jsonb_aggregates;
CREATE INDEX idx_type_matrix_jsonb_payload ON type_matrix_jsonb_operations USING GIN (payload);
SELECT id FROM type_matrix_jsonb_operations WHERE payload @> '{"kind":"patient"}'::jsonb ORDER BY id;
SELECT id FROM type_matrix_jsonb_operations WHERE payload ?| ARRAY['missing','other'] ORDER BY id;
UPDATE type_matrix_jsonb_operations SET payload = '{"kind":"patient"}' WHERE id = 4;
DELETE FROM type_matrix_jsonb_operations WHERE id = 2;
SELECT id FROM type_matrix_jsonb_operations WHERE payload @> '{"kind":"patient"}'::jsonb ORDER BY id;
